title: linum usitatissimum subsp. humile
intro: Linum usitatissimum subsp. humile, commonly known as dwarf flax, is a subspecies of the flax plant that is native to certain regions. This plant has been used for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve skin conditions due to its high content of omega-3 fatty acids and antioxidants. The therapeutic actions of Linum usitatissimum subsp. humile include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which make it useful in treating wounds, skin irritations, and other health issues. The bioactive constituents of Linum usitatissimum subsp. humile include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lignans, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
